name: Citare IA
description: Citare IA searches a curated database of Brazilian legal instruments and returns literal excerpts with citation, source, and current validity status. Coverage includes the Civil Code, Code of Civil Procedure, Labor Code (CLT), Penal Code, Consumer Protection Code, Child and Adolescent Statute, and LGPD; STF and STJ case law summaries (súmulas) and binding precedents; CJF Civil Law Conference interpretive statements; the CNJ Protocol for Judgment with a Gender Perspective; and the OAB/SP Fee Schedule. Built for legal professionals who need traceable legal grounding for review. It does not predict case outcomes, does not substitute for professional legal advice, and does not cover foreign law.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Citare IA to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Citare IA to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.ragcloud.com.br/functions/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Citare IA MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Citare IA provides these MCP tools: buscar_instrumento_juridico.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Citare IA?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Citare IA in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Citare IA MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Citare IA requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Citare IA is developed by code.py Programação e IA. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
